title: What the TotalEnergies Exit Means for Netcompany-Ineos
content:
French company TotalEnergies is leaving its deal with Netcompany-Ineos to pivot into the women's peloton and back Demi Vollering.

Read the full article at What the TotalEnergies Exit Means for Netcompany-Ineos on Velo.
